name: groundwork
description: Spec-driven development framework: Socratic discovery, PRDs, ADRs, tracer-bullet issues, TDD execution, and review.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven development, from a fuzzy idea to a reviewed diff.
interface.longDescription: Turns "let's build X" into a PRD, sharpened by a one-question-at-a-time interview, recorded as append-only ADRs, broken into tracer-bullet vertical slices, built with TDD, and reviewed against both the coding standards and the spec that motivated it - as much or as little of that as a task actually needs. Tracker-agnostic: GitHub, Linear, or a local checklist.
